tables.description: Order header fact table (Zero-Copy BigLake Iceberg). Grain: 1 row per delivery order (ORD_ID). Filter ORD_STS_CD = 'D' for realized revenue. WARNING: TIP_USD passes 100% to couriers and MUST NEVER be included in Platform Net Revenue.

columns.ORD_ID: Unique delivery order identifier (e.g., ORD-0000001). Primary key.
columns.ORD_DT_SK: Integer date surrogate key (YYYYMMDD) joining to SYS_CAL_DIM.DT_SK.
columns.MRC_ID: Merchant partner identifier joining to MRC_PARTNER_MSTR.MRC_ID and MRC_COMM_SCD2.MRC_ID.
columns.CRR_ID: Assigned courier identifier joining to CRR_COURIER_MSTR.CRR_ID.
columns.ZONE_ID: Delivery zone identifier joining to GEO_ZONE_LKP.ZONE_ID.
columns.VERT_CD: Marketplace vertical code: 1 = Restaurant (Hot Food), 2 = Grocery (Quick-Commerce Dark Stores).
columns.ORD_STS_CD: Order lifecycle status code: D = Delivered (realized), P = Preparing, C = Customer Cancelled, R = Merchant Rejected.
columns.DLV_FEE_USD: Delivery fee paid by customer (USD). Included in Platform Net Revenue.
columns.SRV_FEE_USD: Platform service fee paid by customer (USD). Included in Platform Net Revenue.
columns.TIP_USD: Pass-through courier tip (USD). Goes 100% to couriers — NEVER include in Platform Net Revenue.
columns.CRR_PAY_USD: Courier payout cost paid by UrbanFork (USD). Deducted from Platform Net Revenue.
columns.PROMO_VOUCHER_USD: UrbanFork-funded promotional voucher subsidy (USD). Deducted from Platform Net Revenue.

tables.description: Order item line detail (Zero-Copy BigLake Iceberg). Grain: 1 row per item SKU line (ORD_LN_ID). GMV = SUM(QTY_N * UNIT_PRC_USD). ANTI-FANOUT RULE: Always pre-aggregate GMV at ORD_ID grain before joining DSP_REFUND_FCT.

columns.ORD_ID: Parent order identifier joining to DLV_ORD_HDR.ORD_ID.
columns.UNIT_PRC_USD: Unit item price in USD. Basket GMV = SUM(QTY_N * UNIT_PRC_USD).

tables.description: Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 (SCD2) merchant commission contract history. CRITICAL JOIN RULE: Always join on CAL_DT BETWEEN EFF_FROM_DT AND EFF_TO_DT. NEVER filter IS_CURR_FLG = 1 for historical revenue (causes +$127,296.80 Q3 2025 overstatement!).

columns.EFF_TO_DT: Contract effective end date (inclusive; 9999-12-31 for active contract).
columns.COMM_RATE_PCT: Contracted merchant commission rate applied to Basket GMV (decimal, e.g., 0.24 = 24%).
columns.IS_CURR_FLG: 1 = Currently active contract version, 0 = Historical version. Do NOT use IS_CURR_FLG = 1 for historical period calculations.

tables.description: Customer dispute and refund events. Grain: 1 row per dispute ticket (DSP_ID). Filter RFND_STS_FLG = 1 for Approved Refunds. ANTI-FANOUT RULE: Pre-aggregate by ORD_ID before joining item lines (prevents 3.27x refund overcounting).

columns.ORD_ID: Disputed order identifier joining to DLV_ORD_HDR.ORD_ID.
columns.RFND_AMT_USD: Refund dollar amount requested/issued (USD). Sum only when RFND_STS_FLG = 1.
columns.RFND_STS_FLG: Refund status flag: 0 = Pending Review, 1 = Approved Refund (deducted from Net Revenue), 9 = Rejected Suspected Abuse.
columns.DSP_RSN_CD: Dispute reason code: 1 = Missing Item (Quality), 2 = Cold/Spilled Food (Quality), 3 = Extreme Late SLA, 4 = Suspected Refund Abuse.
columns.CUST_TICKET_TXT: Free-text customer support ticket message classified by BigQuery AI.CLASSIFY / AI.SCORE.

tables.description: 15-minute live courier fleet availability snapshots per delivery zone (Zero-Copy BigLake Iceberg). SNAPSHOT TRAP WARNING: ONLINE_CRR_N, BUSY_CRR_N, and UNASSIGNED_ORD_N are NON-ADDITIVE stock measures. NEVER SUM across SNAP_TS; always isolate the latest SNAP_TS per zone or query DT_LIVE_ZONE_SUPPLY_DEFICIT.

columns.SNAP_TS: 15-minute fleet snapshot timestamp (UTC). Filter to MAX(SNAP_TS) per ZONE_ID.
columns.ONLINE_CRR_N: Point-in-time online couriers in zone (non-additive across time).
columns.BUSY_CRR_N: Point-in-time couriers actively on a delivery (non-additive across time).
columns.UNASSIGNED_ORD_N: Point-in-time waiting orders without an assigned courier.

tables.description: Merchant payout settlements and dispute chargeback ledger (Zero-Copy BigLake Iceberg). HIDDEN JOIN RULE: Chargeback rows join to orders via CONCAT('CBK-', ORD_ID) = REF_DOC_TXT.

columns.REF_DOC_TXT: Reference document string: 'STL-...' for scheduled merchant payouts, 'CBK-<ORD_ID>' for dispute chargebacks.
columns.LEDGER_AMT_USD: Signed ledger amount (positive = payout credit, negative = chargeback deduction).
columns.PYT_STS_FLG: Payout status flag: 0 = Scheduled Payout, 1 = Paid/Settled, 9 = Held for Compliance Review.

tables.description: Corporate fiscal calendar dimension. IMPORTANT: UrbanFork Fiscal Year starts on February 1st (FISC_YR_N / FISC_QTR_N differ from calendar quarters!).

columns.FISC_QTR_N: UrbanFork Fiscal Quarter (Q1 = Feb-Apr, Q2 = May-Jul, Q3 = Aug-Oct, Q4 = Nov-Jan).

tables.description: Mobile delivery app telemetry pings migrated from Snowflake VARIANT to native BigQuery JSON. TELEMETRY BUG RULE: Always exclude LAX_STRING(PAYLOAD.app_ver) = '3.8.0-beta' (1,933 orders have corrupted GPS kitchen prep timers).

columns.PAYLOAD: Native BigQuery JSON telemetry document containing app_ver, stage ('DELIVERED'), metrics.prep_sec, metrics.travel_sec, metrics.eta_sec, and anomaly_flags.

tables.description: Certified Gold daily marketplace profitability fact table (Dataform + Tableau Cloud Live). Encodes SCD2 merchant commission lookup, anti-fanout approved refund deduction, and excludes pass-through courier tips. Official Benchmarks: Q3 2025 Calendar Restaurant Net Revenue = $153,150.49; FY25 Restaurant = $937,401.38; FY25 Grocery = $38,309.66.

columns.GROSS_MERCHANDISE_VALUE_USD: Total Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of completed delivered orders (USD).
columns.APPROVED_REFUNDS_USD: Total approved customer refunds (RFND_STS_FLG = 1), deduplicated at order grain.
columns.PLATFORM_NET_REVENUE_USD: Official UrbanFork Platform Net Revenue (Net Take): Merchant SCD2 Commission + Delivery & Service Fees - Courier Pay - Promo Vouchers - Approved Refunds (excludes Courier Tips).
columns.EFFECTIVE_TAKE_RATE_PCT: Platform Net Revenue divided by GMV (Tableau Calculated Field: Effective Take-Rate %).

tables.description: Certified Gold merchant tiering scorecard (Dataform + Tableau Cloud Live). A merchant earns IS_PRIME_PARTNER = TRUE iff trailing 90-day GMV > $25,000 AND avg kitchen prep < 14.0 min (excluding 3.8.0-beta) AND quality dispute rate < 2.0% AND rejection rate < 1.0%.

columns.TRAILING_90D_GMV_USD: Completed delivered GMV over trailing 90 days (USD).
columns.AVG_PREP_MIN_90D: Clean average kitchen prep time in minutes over trailing 90 days (excludes app_ver 3.8.0-beta).
columns.QUALITY_DISPUTE_RATE: Share of delivered orders with approved quality disputes (DSP_RSN_CD IN (1,2) AND RFND_STS_FLG = 1).
columns.MERCHANT_REJECTION_RATE: Share of total orders rejected by merchant (ORD_STS_CD = 'R').
columns.IS_PRIME_PARTNER: Boolean flag: TRUE when merchant satisfies all 4 corporate Prime Partner criteria.

tables.description: Certified Gold live courier supply deficit mart (migrated from Snowflake Dynamic Table; Tableau Cloud Live). Safely isolated to the latest fleet snapshot per zone (avoids Snapshot Trap). Critical Deficit Zone threshold: SUPPLY_DEFICIT_RATIO >= 2.50.

columns.LATEST_SNAP_TS: Latest 15-minute fleet snapshot timestamp per zone.
columns.ONLINE_CRR_N: Latest live online couriers count in the zone.
columns.UNASSIGNED_ORD_N: Current unassigned delivery orders waiting for dispatch.
columns.SUPPLY_DEFICIT_RATIO: Unassigned orders divided by idle couriers. >= 2.50 triggers Critical Surge Dispatch Alert.
